newsitem.title: DUBAI: Shares in Oman end the week broadly stable.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Oman end the week broadly stable.

text.p: Shares on Oman's stock exchange ended the week to Wednesday little changed in trade dominated by banks, investment firms and industrials, the bourse said.
The Muscat Securities Market (MSM) said the index closed at 187.25 points from 187.08 points from the previous week.
Of the 58 companies traded in the week, prices of 21 rose, 24 fell and 13 were steady, it added.
There was heavy trade in companies which look set to benefit from a newly-decreed change in the tax law, which will streamline taxes on local firms and those with foreign shareholders, the MSM said.
It said 2.66 million shares were traded, up 35 percent on the previous week. The value of shares traded rose almost 18 percent to 5.57 million rials ($14.7 million) in the week.
Banks and investment firms accounted for 60 percent of total trading value, followed by industrials with 30 percent. Services and insurance stocks accounted for a respective seven and three percent.
Some 339,000 Oman International Development and Investment Co shares worth around 901,000 rials were traded. The share closed at 2.810 rials from last week's 2.800 rials.
Oman International Bank was another active stock with 266,000 shares worth 680,000 rials changing hands. It closed at 2.570 rials from 2.540 rials.
